training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Same 25% color quartets, 25% navigation, 40% state calibration, 10% retained primitive schedule. State calibration uses one same-image quartet [v,-v,0,v/2] per microbatch; domains 25/25/50% and tasks 2..6 cycle. Common flow noise/time across the quartet; t=1 on even steps, sampled common time on odd steps. Other sampling unchanged.
training.loss: Flow matching on six normalized action channels, weights [8,8,1,4,1,1], divided by their sum. Runtime units and normalization unchanged.
training.data: Same dataset10 images and states. Relabel stationary horizontal braking and airborne rotation yaw only.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.
training.image_domains: Explicit per-image domains; new views are appended after the 6408 existing image IDs.
training.noise_schedule: For step=1..6000 and micro=0..1, use the frozen runtime Gaussian realization if (step+micro)%4<2, otherwise fresh random noise. 50% each. Existing common-noise quartet rules and flow-time schedule unchanged.
training.rationale: Address observed horizontal drift and rotation overshoot with training-only target changes. Preserve navigation and landing labels. No runtime or score changes.

teacher.scope: Training labels only; frozen velocity-to-attitude controller already subtracts current estimated velocity.
teacher.nonhorizontal_labels: Preserve all except yaw for rotation tasks 4/5 when captured state is armed and altitude >0.8m.
teacher.reason: H06/H11 insufficient physical hover with horizontal drift; H12 overshot scan and target near frame edge; H16 acquired red then lost it at right edge while drifting. Median capture-to-first-execution latency across16 development cases is0.9105s. Navigation error may persist; improvement is a hypothesis.
teacher.stationary_horizontal_command: -1.2 * input estimated horizontal velocity; norm cap0.2m/s, constant32 steps. Zero unarmed or takeoff below0.25m.
teacher.yaw_target_rule: For armed rotation above0.8m: initial predicted yaw=own_yaw+1.0*own_yaw_rate. Iterate32 times at0.1s; rate=0 inside0.03rad else clip(0.8*(target-predicted_yaw), +/-0.25).

data.unchanged: All image/state/task input arrays, English prompts, sampling pools, flow-time/noise schedules, loss weights, navigation/landing labels, runtime and scoring.

evaluation: Unchanged: dev 8/8; exposed stress >=14/16, >=7/8 each color, >=3/4 each layout; regression 5/5; known failure 1/1; then fresh matched 16 per model and preregistered static probe.
hypotheses_not_results: Stronger training-only horizontal braking may reduce drift in stationary phases. No gain of the runtime controller is changed.
Yaw training labels anticipate1.0s delay using own yaw rate and cap teacher yaw at0.25rad/s; runtime cap remains0.35rad/s.
H16 also shows navigation-direction error; these target changes may not fix it. All subsequent runs, including failures, remain reportable.
No development images or states become training examples. Fresh round02 remains unexposed.
Multiple teacher changes plus continuation training prevent isolated causal attribution.

resources.training: Windows GPU, no WSL training; no flight concurrent with training
resources.scope: Project WSL process tree only; other user workloads and global WSL settings untouched
